# Open Education Alberta Pressbooks

> > Open educational resources catalogue hosted on Pressbooks, featuring interactive OER textbooks with H5P activities across multiple disciplines including language learning, typography, and engineering.

Open Education Alberta Pressbooks serves as a publishing platform for open educational resources (OER) available under Creative Commons licenses. The catalogue includes textbooks with interactive H5P exercises, supporting post-secondary education across Alberta institutions including the University of Alberta Library.

## Key Topics

- Open Education Alberta
- Pressbooks
- H5P interactive activities
- OER textbooks
- Creative Commons licensing
- German language learning (Willkommen series)
- Typography Handbook
- University of Alberta Library
- Course Presentation
- Drag the Words exercises
- Question Set activities
- Open educational resources
- Interactive learning content
- Educational publishing platform

## Getting Started

- [Open Education Alberta Pressbooks Catalogue](https://pressbooks.openeducationalberta.ca/): Homepage and main catalogue of OER textbooks and educational resources

## German Language Learning Resources

- [Willkommen: Deutsch für alle - H5P Activities (Page 18)](https://pressbooks.openeducationalberta.ca/willkommen-deutsch/h5p-listing/?hpage=18): Interactive H5P exercises for German language learning textbook
- [Willkommen: Deutsch für alle 2 - H5P Activities (Page 9)](https://pressbooks.openeducationalberta.ca/willkommen-deutsch-2/h5p-listing/?hpage=9): H5P interactive activities index for second-level German textbook

## Design and Typography

- [Typography Handbook - Classifications](https://pressbooks.openeducationalberta.ca/typographyhandbook/part/classifications/): Typeface classifications guide by David Piechnik

## Engineering and Library Resources

- [Citation Help - Chemical and Materials Engineering](https://pressbooks.openeducationalberta.ca/cme200lib/chapter/citation-help/): Citation styles guide from University of Alberta Library for engineering students
